name: PoliceScanner
concept: The police scanner the fence sells in 1989 Everon: a pocketable VHF band receiver in black plastic that picks up the service calls. A player holds it upright in one fist, with its short stub antenna at the top and the speaker grille on the front.
prompt: Late-1980s hand-held VHF band scanner receiver: an upright rounded-rectangle black ABS body, a short stubby rubber antenna on top, a small LCD frequency window high on the front, a grid of small keypad buttons under it and a speaker grille at the bottom. no text, no logos.
